title: Photography Policy
content: Photography guidelines for visiting Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha.

insideSanctum.reason: To maintain the sanctity and privacy of worship

outsideTemple.note: External photography of temple architecture is permitted

flashPhotography.reason: Flash can disturb other devotees and damage ancient paintings

videoRecording.reason: Video recording inside temple premises is not allowed

tips: For professional photography or videography, please contact the temple office for prior permission.
